title: For all their talk about AI, few companies are quantifying gains
title_zh: 尽管他们都在谈论人工智能，但很少有公司会量化收益
summary: Is any money being made from AI?

title: How Apple's John Ternus inherited a 'reckoning' with China
title_zh: 苹果公司的约翰·特努斯如何继承对中国的“清算”
summary: Strategy Risks founder and CEO, Isaac Stone Fish, sits down with Market Domination host Josh Lipton to discuss various aspects of Apple's (AAPL) overall strategy in China, India, and more.
summary_zh: Strategy Risks 创始人兼首席执行官 Isaac Stone Fish 与《市场支配》主持人 Josh Lipton 坐下来讨论苹果 (AAPL) 在中国、印度等地区总体战略的各个方面。

title: Tesla's Cybercab event is tonight. Here's what the industry — and Wall Street — expects
title_zh: 特斯拉的 Cyber​​cab 活动将于今晚举行。这是业界和华尔街的期望
summary: Tesla will take the wraps off its production Cybercab purpose-built robotaxi in Austin later today, marking a potential turning point for the company's self-driving ambitions.
summary_zh: 特斯拉将于今天晚些时候在奥斯汀揭晓其生产的 Cyber​​cab 专用机器人出租车，这标志着该公司自动驾驶雄心的一个潜在转折点。

title: Apple facing $2.7 billion UK lawsuit over 'unfair' app tracking rules
title_zh: 苹果因“不公平”的应用程序跟踪规则在英国面临 27 亿美元的诉讼
summary: LONDON, Sept 3 () - Apple is facing a £2 billion ($2.7 billion) London lawsuit brought on behalf of app developers over its app ‌tracking rules, with the iPhone maker accused of abusing its power ‌to unfairly impose greater restrictions on third parties.
summary_zh: 伦敦，9 月 3 日 - 苹果面临着代表应用程序开发商就其应用程序跟踪规则提起的价值 20 亿英镑（27 亿美元）的伦敦诉讼，这家 iPhone 制造商被指控滥用权力，不公平地对第三方施加更大的限制。

title: How Amazon is transforming your Whole Foods run: CEO
title_zh: 亚马逊如何改变全食超市的运营：首席执行官
summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi sits down with Whole Foods Market CEO Jason Buechel to discuss how Amazon's latest tech is reshaping the grocery giant.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经执行编辑 Brian Sozzi 与 Whole Foods Market 首席执行官 Jason Buechel 坐下来讨论亚马逊的最新技术如何重塑这家杂货巨头。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures waver as investors weigh Middle East tensions
title_zh: 今日股市：投资者权衡中东紧张局势，道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货波动
summary: Markets searched for gains after three days of declines and as investors looked ahead to Friday's labor market report.
summary_zh: 市场在连续三天下跌后寻求上涨，投资者期待周五的劳动力市场报告。

title: Steve Ballmer banned, Clippers fined $30M over Kawhi Leonard scandal
title_zh: 史蒂夫·鲍尔默因科怀·伦纳德丑闻被禁赛，快船队被罚款 3000 万美元
summary: Asking for a Trend, Host Josh Lipton breaks down the latest bombshell in the NBA scandal involving Los Angeles Clippers owner and former Microsoft (MSFT) CEO Steve Ballmer, as the league hands down sweeping penalties following its investigation into the Clippers’ handling of K...
summary_zh: 在寻求趋势时，主持人乔什·利普顿 (Josh Lipton) 剖析了涉及洛杉矶快船队老板和前微软 (MSFT) 首席执行官史蒂夫·鲍尔默 (Steve Ballmer) 的 NBA 丑闻中的最新重磅炸弹，联盟在对快船队处理 K 的方式进行调查后做出了全面处罚。

title: Broadcom's Q3 earnings beat just isn't 'enough' to keep investors happy
title_zh: 博通第三季度盈利超出预期并不足以让投资者满意
summary: Broadcom (AVGO) reported third quarter earnings results that modestly beat Wall Street's estimates. StoneX Financial equity research analyst Cody Acree shares his thoughts on the earnings print.
summary_zh: 博通（AVGO）公布的第三季度盈利结果略好于华尔街的预期。 StoneX Financial 股票研究分析师 Cody Acree 分享了他对财报的看法。

title: Tesla's Cybercab to take center stage at Austin event
title_zh: 特斯拉的 Cyber​​cab 将在奥斯汀活动中占据中心舞台
summary: Tesla (TSLA) will be holding an event for its driverless Cybercab in Austin, Texas, on Thursday. Yahoo Finance Senior Autos Reporter Pras Subramanian breaks down what to expect from the EV company and its robotaxi service.
summary_zh: 特斯拉 (TSLA) 将于周四在德克萨斯州奥斯汀举办无人驾驶 Cyber​​cab 活动。雅虎财经高级汽车记者 Pras Subramanian 详细分析了人们对这家电动汽车公司及其机器人出租车服务的期望。
